# 4 bed detached house for sale

> Welcome to Ayresfield, Granges Road, Kilkenny an exceptional five-bedroom detached executive residence occupying a substantial private site in one of Kilkenny's most sought-after residential locations. This magnificent home is ideally positioned within easy walking distance of Kilkenny City Centre and all the amenities the city has to offer.
